5.1 visualize 工具 — 图表类型白名单校验

const CHART_TYPES = [
  "bar", "line", "scatter", "histogram",
  "pie", "box", "heatmap",
] as const;

const chartType = args.chart_type;
if (!CHART_TYPES.includes(chartType as any)) {
  return { content: [...], details: { error: "unsupported_chart_type" } };
}

// Python 脚本参数校验
const MAX_WIDTH = 1200, MAX_HEIGHT = 900;
const width = Math.min(args.width ?? 800, MAX_WIDTH);
const height = Math.min(args.height ?? 600, MAX_HEIGHT);

5.2 口径回写 — ask_clarification 结果写入 agent.md

// src/hooks/active-questioning.ts
private recordCaliber(
  question: string, option: AskOption,
  datasetFingerprint?: string
): void {
  const caliber: CaliberEntry = {
    question,
    selectedOptionId: option.id,
    selectedOptionLabel: option.label,
    impliedAssumption: option.implied_assumption,
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    datasetFingerprint,
  };
  const existing = this.persistence.getAgentMdContent();
  // 去重：相同 question 替换
  const updated = existing.filter((e) => e.question !== question);
  updated.push(caliber);
  // 截断：只保留最近 20 条
  const trimmed = updated.slice(-20);
  this.persistence.saveAgentMd(trimmed, "project");
}

5.3 过时闸 — schema fingerprint 检测

// src/hooks/query-memory.ts
hasStaleQueries(): boolean {
  const current = this.currentDatasetFingerprint;
  if (!current) return false;
  return this.memory.entries.some(
    (e) => e.datasetFingerprint &&
           e.datasetFingerprint !== current
  );
}

generatePromptInjection(): string {
  // ...
  if (this.hasStaleQueries()) {
    lines.push("⚠ Schema Change Detected!");
    lines.push("Queries below may be outdated:");
  }
  // 过时查询被标记但不参与召回
}

5.4 失败查询入库 — 错误分类 + 独立容量闸

// src/pii-guard.ts（classifyError 简化版）
const FAILURE_PATTERNS = [
  { category: "syntax_error",
    patterns: [/syntax error/i, /parser error/i, ...] },
  { category: "not_found",
    patterns: [/table.*not found/i, /does not exist/i, ...] },
  { category: "permission",
    patterns: [/permission denied/i, /security blocked/i, ...] },
  { category: "timeout",
    patterns: [/timeout/i, /timed out/i, ...] },
];

// 独立容量闸
private static readonly MAX_FAILED_ENTRIES = 10;
private failedQueries: FailedQueryEntry[] = [];

recordFailedQuery(params: { ... }): void {
  // 入库失败不影响主流程
  try { ... } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[QueryMemory] Failed to record failed query:", err);
  }
}

5.5 PII 脱敏 — 纯正则零依赖

// src/pii-guard.ts
const PII_RULES = [
  { type: "id_card",
    pattern: /\b\d{6}(?:19|20)\d{2}(?:0[1-9]|1[0-2])...
    mask: (m) => m.slice(0, 6) + "******" + m.slice(-4) },
  { type: "phone",
    pattern: /\b1[3-9]\d{9}\b/,
    mask: (m) => m.slice(0, 3) + "****" + m.slice(-4) },
  { type: "email",
    pattern: /\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}\b/,
    mask: (m) => { const [l, d] = m.split("@");
      return l[0] + "***" + l[l.length-1] + "@" + d; } },
];

// 接入 data-dictionary sampleValues 生成
sampleValues: sample.slice(0, 3).map((row) => {
  const raw = String(row[...]);
  return maskPII(raw).masked;  // 脱敏后进入 prompt
})

9. 已知问题与风险

P1（建议在 v0.3 前修复）

#问题位置影响风险等级
1 数据字典缺少用户确认环节（ctx.ui.confirm()） src/hooks/data-dictionary.ts 字典自动生成标记 ai-guessed，用户无法修正。Spec 要求 LLM 推断 + 用户确认 中
2 查询记忆淘汰公式与 Spec 不符 src/hooks/query-memory.ts 当前线性衰减 useCount * 1/(1+daysAgo)，Spec 要求 log(useCount+1) * exp(-recency/7天) * relevanceScore 中
3 buildCountSql() 正则可能误删子查询 LIMIT src/engine/duckdb.ts 正则只匹配末尾 LIMIT，子查询中的 LIMIT 可能被误删 低
